Strategy: Drop the sliver penalty and keep only the winning bonus band between twenty-eight and forty-two, testing whether the reward alone beats Best Fit. It may help by simplifying the rule, but may fail if the penalty was doing real work against dead slivers.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) for r in bins]
```
